Send Our Advantages Specialization National Platform Vast Track Record Client Focus & Commitment TO ADVISE, ONE NEEDS TO TRULY SPECIALIZE The Fortis Net Lease team of brokers are among the most experienced and distinguished in the industry due to our specialization. Ranging from the Retail to Medical sectors, 1031 exchanges to new developments, Net Lease Assets are our area specialty. Our Advisory Services include property evaluations, strategic portfolio analysis and guidance, property acquisitions & dispositions, client / property specific marketing planning and implementation. Our ability to provide our clients with unique, creative, and evolving advisory services, launches our brokers one step ahead of our competition. TO MAXIMIZE RESULTS, MAXIMIZE THE PLATFORM In order to achieve the very best results for our clients, we realize the need to maximize the reach of our platform and national marketing footprint. We leave no stone unturned in our efforts to reach as many buyers and brokers across the country as possible. Attaining the best price for your property, with the most attractive deal terms, from the most qualified buyer requires your broker to engage everyone, from the very first day of an assignment. We practice what we preach, and do this by utilizing every marketing medium available. THE BEST KNOWLEDGE, COMES FROM REAL EXPERIENCE. Over the past decade, our focus has been on the acquisition and disposition of net leased real estate with nationally recognized tenants, as well as client advisory. Our team has successfully sold over $9 Billion in real estate on behalf of private investors, real estate developers, and institutional investors throughout the country. With over 4,500 properties sold, our knowledge is based on real transactional experience as there truly is no substitute. LONG-TERM RELATIONSHIP BASED The foundation of Fortis Net Lease is rooted in our desire to better serve our clients in every aspect of the real estate holding and selling continuum. With a robust support network, our agents are always engaged in offering support, negotiating deals, working with clients, and strengthening buyer outreach. Our goals have become our client’s goals, and has allowed for the creation of many long-term client relationships that include: Palmetto Capital Group, The Zaremba Group, Agree Realty Corporation, VEREIT, American Realty Capital, Realty Income, STORE Capital, Capital Growth Buchalter, Spirit Realty, ALRIG, Viking Partners, GMX Real Estate, Hunt Real Estate, Oldacre MacDonald and many more. We pride ourselves in the marketing information that we provide to the buyer and brokerage community, and we hold ourselves accountable. When given an assignment, we require complete and accurate information from our sellers, therefore preventing misrepresentations that could hurt the sale during due diligence. MAXIMUM EXPOSURE In today’s market, a proactive and expansive national marketing platform and strategy is paramount. In order to attain the best offer, from the best buyer, with the most attractive terms, a broker needs to maximize the exposure of a property. We maximize exposure from day one by fully engaging every commercial real estate marketing medium available. Rather than making one post or sending one email advertisement, a truly effective marketing campaign needs to evolve. We treat every deal with the greatest level of importance, which translates into continued and thorough marketing advertisements, while always searching for additional marketing tools and avenues. RELATIONSHIP WITH SELLERS We value the relationships we have with our clients above all else. No commercial real estate broker retires off of one transaction, but rather a long career full of many transactions. Our goal is to create long-term relationships with each and every client, and we have done this by accomplishing our clients’ short- and long-term goals. Our clients routinely become more than just clients, but also friends. BUYER REACH AND REPRESENTATION The key to maximizing exposure is being able to effectively and efficiently reach the largest buyer pool possible. Fortis Net Lease’s marketing platform reaches one of the industry’s largest net lease buyer pools, reaching buyers of all shapes and economic sizes, both nationally and internationally. Buyer representation makes up a core part of business, as our buyer clients’ needs, and goals are our marching orders and we pride ourselves by exceeding expectations. We focus on exposure from both the seller’s and the buyer’s point of view, not only to push the exposure of our listed properties but by also ensuring that we as brokers are exposed to the latest net leased property advertisements and marketing campaigns. This allows us to provide every available option to our buyers, while also providing important market intel and color. BROKER COLLABORATION AND CONFIDENCE Due to the number of transactions we handle, a large portion of the stores we sell include an outside broker, thus making the brokerage community our largest and best client.
